description: Percona Search for MongoDB (mongot) at a glance: is search up, error-free, fast, fresh and not running out of disk or heap. Drill down in MongoDB Search Details.

panels.title: Overall
panels.description: Number of mongot services with at least one signal in its red band (down, errors, slow, stale, index not STEADY, disk or heap). 0 = everything is fine. The table below shows which service and why.

targets.expr: count(count by (service_name) ((max by (service_name) (up{service_name=~"$service_name"}) == 0) or (sum by (service_name) (rate({__name__=~"mongot_command_(search|vectorSearch|getMore)CommandFailure_total",service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])) >= 1) or (max by (service_name) ({__name__=~"mongot_command_(search|vectorSearch)CommandTotalLatency_seconds",service_name=~"$service_name",quantile="0.99"}) >= 0.5) or (max by (service_name) (mongot_index_stats_indexing_replicationLagMs{service_name=~"$service_name"}) >= 60000) or (count by (service_name) (mongot_index_stats_indexStatusCode{service_name=~"$service_name",status!="STEADY"} == 1) > 0) or (100 * min by (service_name) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_free_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name"} / mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_total_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name"}) <= 15) or (100 * sum by (service_name) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name",area="heap"}) / sum by (service_name) (mongot_jvm_memory_max_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name",area="heap"} > 0) >= 90))) or (count(max by (service_name) (up{service_name=~"$service_name"})) * 0)

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: mongot services PMM cannot scrape. A hung or stopped mongot shows here (its own error counters stay at 0 while hung).

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Failed $search, $vectorSearch and getMore commands per second over the last 5 minutes, all selected services. Orange above 0.01/s, red from 1/s.

panels.title: Latency P99
panels.description: Worst P99 latency of $search / $vectorSearch across the selected services. Orange from 100 ms, red from 500 ms.

panels.title: Freshness
panels.description: Worst replication lag: how far behind MongoDB the search indexes are, i.e. how stale search results can be. Orange from 10 s, red from 60 s.

panels.title: Index Health
panels.description: Indexes whose status is not STEADY (FAILED, DOES_NOT_EXIST, INITIAL_SYNC, RECOVERING_*, NOT_STARTED, STALE). Any is red.

panels.title: Disk Free
panels.description: Lowest free space on a mongot data path. mongot pauses replication at 10% free. Orange at 25%, red at 15%.

panels.title: Heap
panels.description: Highest JVM heap usage across the selected services. Orange from 75%, red from 90%.

panels.title: Health by Service
panels.description: Same signals per mongot service, coloured with the same thresholds. Click a service name to open MongoDB Search Details for it.

targets.expr: count by (service_name) ((max by (service_name) (up{service_name=~"$service_name"}) == 0) or (sum by (service_name) (rate({__name__=~"mongot_command_(search|vectorSearch|getMore)CommandFailure_total",service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m])) >= 1) or (max by (service_name) ({__name__=~"mongot_command_(search|vectorSearch)CommandTotalLatency_seconds",service_name=~"$service_name",quantile="0.99"}) >= 0.5) or (max by (service_name) (mongot_index_stats_indexing_replicationLagMs{service_name=~"$service_name"}) >= 60000) or (count by (service_name) (mongot_index_stats_indexStatusCode{service_name=~"$service_name",status!="STEADY"} == 1) > 0) or (100 * min by (service_name) (mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_free_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name"} / mongot_system_disk_space_data_path_total_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name"}) <= 15) or (100 * sum by (service_name) (mongot_jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name",area="heap"}) / sum by (service_name) (mongot_jvm_memory_max_bytes{service_name=~"$service_name",area="heap"} > 0) >= 90)) or (max by (service_name) (up{service_name=~"$service_name"}) * 0)

panels.title: Latency P99 Trend
panels.description: Worst $search / $vectorSearch P99 per service. Red line = 500 ms.

panels.title: Freshness Trend
panels.description: Worst replication lag per service. Red line = 60 s.

panels.title: Errors Trend
panels.description: Failed search commands per second per service.
